summary: A BYGG GRUPPEN AS (org. no. 943 646 198) is a private limited company (AS) based in Oslo, in the Brønnøysund registers since 1995-02-19. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 68.120 (Utvikling og salg av byggeprosjekter); it has 0 registered employees. In its 2025 accounts (company level) net income was NOK 40 981. CEO: Morten Raugstad; board chair: Erik Stensli; auditor: PRICEWATERHOUSECOOPERS AS.
